kurals.tr: Pataikuti Koozhamaichchu Natparan Aarum / Utaiyaan Arasarul Eru
kurals.m: He who possesses these six things, an army, a people, wealth, ministers, friends and a fortress, is a lion among kings

kurals.tr: Anjaamai Eekai Arivookkam Innaankum / Enjaamai Vendhark Kiyalpu
kurals.m: Never to fail in these four things, fearlessness, liberality, wisdom, and energy, is the kingly character

kurals.tr: Thoongaamai Kalvi Thunivutaimai Immoondrum / Neengaa Nilanaan Pavarkku
kurals.m: These three things, viz, vigilance, learning, and bravery, should never be wanting in the ruler of a country

kurals.tr: Aranizhukkaa Thallavai Neekki Maranizhukkaa / Maanam Utaiya Tharasu
kurals.m: He is a king who, with manly modesty, swerves not from virtue, and refrains from vice

kurals.tr: Iyatralum Eettalung Kaaththalum Kaaththa / Vakuththalum Valla Tharasu
kurals.m: He is a king who is able to acquire (wealth), to lay it up, to guard, and to distribute it

kurals.tr: Kaatchik Keliyan Katunjollan Allanel / Meekkoorum Mannan Nilam
kurals.m: The whole world will exalt the country of the king who is easy of access, and who is free from harsh language

kurals.tr: Insolaal Eeththalikka Vallaarkkuth Thansolaal / Thaankan Tanaiththiv Vulaku
kurals.m: The world will praise and submit itself to the mind of the king who is able to give with affability, and to protect all who come to him

kurals.tr: Muraiseydhu Kaappaatrum Mannavan Makkatku / Iraiyendru Vaikkap Patum
kurals.m: That king, will be esteemed a God among men, who performs his own duties, and protects (his subjects).

kurals.tr: Sevikaippach Chorporukkum Panputai Vendhan / Kavikaikkeezhth Thangum Ulaku
kurals.m: The whole world will dwell under the umbrella of the king, who can bear words that embitter the ear

kurals.tr: Kotaiyali Sengol Kutiyompal Naankum / Utaiyaanaam Vendhark Koli
kurals.m: He is the light of kings who has there four things, beneficence, benevolence, rectitude, and care for his people
